turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Explain how you would validate a SQL metric.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I compare row counts, null rates, and sampled records against the source.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Randomization quality and sample ratio mismatch are early checks.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How would you communicate the uncertainty?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would show the interval and explain what is and is not supported.
